## Ask

Two halves of one capability:

1. **Discovery** — a bot that scrapes the internet for work worth doing: FOSS issues,
   bounties, help-wanted labels, and paid engagements, feeding candidates into the
   conductor's intake with provenance (where found, what it asks, what it pays if anything).
2. **Ideation** — search the internet, do actual research, and propose **new projects to
   build**: FOSS projects worth existing, and paid/for-hire project ideas — each proposal
   arriving with the evidence that motivated it, not just a name.

## Constraints

- Discovered FOSS work is done free, always — it routes through the unbillable path
  (monetization issue #86). The bot must classify FOSS vs paid at intake and that
  classification is auditable.
- Scraping is polite: robots.txt, rate limits, identified user agent. This bot represents
  the project publicly.
- Proposals are proposals — a human accepts before the conductor spends a cycle. The bot
  ranks and evidences; it does not commission.
- Research output cites sources, in the same evidence-grounded style as vibey-skills.

## Fit

Natural front door to the six-phase conductor: discovery/ideation feeds the spec-interview
phase with pre-researched candidates instead of a blank page.

Made-With: Vibey, the auto-vibecoding machine by Adam Matthew Steinberger

## Triage — 2026-09-17 (`develop` @ f2467910, v0.8.0)

**Status: NOT STARTED** · size **L** · confidence high

**The ask, as read:** Build a bot that (1) discovers FOSS issues, bounties and paid engagements across the internet and feeds them into the conductor's intake with provenance, and (2) researches and proposes new projects to build, with cited evidence - polite scraping, auditable FOSS-vs-paid classification, and human acceptance before any cycle is spent.

### What already ships
- Nothing from the ask. The nearest existing machinery is src/vibey_tools/gh/vibey_gh/issue_automation.py:1-22, which classifies issues in THIS repository, gates them behind a maintainer label and an authority check, and budgets attempts against a fingerprint of the title and body. It is single-repo intake with no internet reach, no FOSS/paid classification and no ranking.

### Evidence in the tree
- src/vibey_tools/ contains only bootstrap, gh, skills - the package the plan names (src/vibey_tools/explorer) does not exist
- docs/runbooks/expansion/21-vibey-explorer.md:3-5 'Status (2026-09-15): not started. It ships as a uv workspace member (src/vibey_tools/explorer) or a vibey-gh capability in this repository' - a plan, not an implementation
- docs/runbooks/expansion/00-master-plan.md status ledger row 21: 'Explorer | Not started | -'
- grep -rniE '(robots\.txt|ideation|bounty|scrape|scraper)' --include='*.py' over the tree returns no implementation - every 'discovery' hit is Azure's AzureDiscoveryResult/discover_environment (src/vibey/application/interfaces/azure.py:20,48) and the single 'help-wanted' hit is a config string in src/vibey_tools/gh/test/test_issue_automation.py:97
- src/vibey/cli/main.py:164 'vibey new' takes only a name and a --repo path; there is no provenance, source, pay or FOSS/paid field anywhere on the intake path
- src/vibey/domain/ledger.py:18-44 EventKind has no candidate/proposal/discovery kind, and migrations/ (11 files, 0001_project.sql .. 0011_deployment_stage_set_phases.sql) has no candidate or proposal table

### What is actually left
- Create src/vibey_tools/explorer as a workspace member (pyproject, Python floor, own gates per ADR-0022)
- Implement the discovery source layer: GitHub/GitLab search for help-wanted and bounty labels first (API, no scraping), then a polite HTTP fetcher with robots.txt parsing, per-host rate limiting and an identified user agent for everything else
- Implement the FOSS-vs-paid classifier as an auditable decision: the input, the rule that fired and the verdict all recorded, not just the label
- Add a provenance-carrying intake path: extend the project record and/or add a candidate table + EventKind so 'where found, what it asks, what it pays' survives into the ledger, and extend `vibey new` (src/vibey/cli/main.py:164) to accept it
- Implement the ideation half: research with cited sources in vibey-skills' evidence-grounded style, producing ranked proposals with the evidence attached
- Add the human-acceptance gate so a proposal parks as a human_gate rather than commissioning a cycle
- Implement the capability-first scoring model (fit gates, attention ranks) and the skip-list for projects whose CONTRIBUTING.md declines machine-authored contributions, both already specified in docs/runbooks/expansion/21-vibey-explorer.md:24-70

### Blockers
- The FOSS-work-is-free routing the issue mandates points at the unbillable path in issue #86, which I did not audit - if that path does not exist, the classifier has nowhere to route to
- Discovered work still needs a provenance-aware intake; today `vibey new` has no field for it, so the intake contract has to change before the bot has anywhere to deliver

**Notes:** This is the only one of the four with no dependency on a hosted platform, a new repo or a UI, and runbook 21 already specifies the hard part (the scoring model and the contribution ethics). A discovery-only first slice - GitHub search plus provenance intake plus ranked candidates, no ideation - is realistically M-to-L on its own; the ideation half with cited research adds roughly another week.
